license_note: No LICENSE file ships in the gated weight repository; the model card embeds and links the Mistral Research License as the governing terms. The MRL grants use, copying, modification, and distribution but limits all use of the model, derivatives, and outputs to non-profit, non-commercial research purposes, with commercial use requiring a separate license from Mistral AI, so the release is source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407 weights and derivatives, embedded in the gated model card

access_boundary: This record represents the mistralai/Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407 weight release of July 2024 at Hugging Face commit a286006d554cb37a61d13c7ae61bc90cc1d372fc (last modified 2025-07-28). Its mistral-large-2407 API line retired on March 30, 2025 with migration directed at Mistral Large 3. The Large 2.1 and Large 3 records, the retired Large 1.0 API line, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Gated 123B dense checkpoint under explicit research-only terms with a 128K context window
Release, retirement, and replacement all dated on first-party docs
tradeoffs: Research-only grant forces any commercial use onto a separate Mistral commercial license
The managed API is retired, leaving self-operation of a 123B model as the supported path
